description: Biology journals including Development, Journal of Cell Science, and Journal of Experimental Biology.
rationale: Use of these journals has fallen every year since FY23, and cost per use rose more than five-fold over the same period. It now has the highest cost per use of any full-text journal package we subscribe to.

description: Journals and conference proceedings from the American Society of Mechanical Engineers.
rationale: Use has declined since FY22, and cost per use has climbed steadily. It returns less value for its cost than our other full-text journal packages.

description: Journals and conference proceedings from the American Society of Civil Engineers.
rationale: Use increased last year, which lowered its cost per use. Even so, its three-year average remains well above most of our other full-text journal packages.

description: Full-text humanities and social sciences journals from university presses and scholarly societies.
rationale: Use has held steady, but its cost per use is higher than most comparable full-text databases.
other_factors: We reviewed how much of Project MUSE is also available through our other resources. About 85% of its journals overlap fully or partially with other resources we provide, and about three-quarters of requests since FY20 were for those journals. The remaining quarter were for journals available only through Project MUSE, and articles from those journals remain available through Interlibrary Loan.
